priority: Complete base toolkits in dependency order before new higher-level expansion. Finish bounded correctness fixes already in flight; preserve other experiments. Permit higher-toolkit work when it is a demonstrated prerequisite of an unmapped base-toolkit legacy test; do not weaken that test to avoid the dependency.
acceptance_gates: Enumerate every supported public API declaration/configuration; retain unresolved platform and parser gaps.
Resolve every declaration to a Rust implementation or explicitly justified upstream nonimplementation; a mapping is not behavioral proof.
Audit actual missing overloads, arguments and observable aliasing/virtual behavior, including APIs already marked implemented.
Port every original legacy declaration without removing assertions; compare native and Rust runtime outcomes for the same cases.
Preserve current pinned behavior, including only explicitly approved legacy skips.
Keep supplemental oracle probes separate from original legacy mappings.

current_work.TKernel: Nullable frees, protected allocator alignment/key helpers, and byte-domain Strtod/Atof are implemented with native probes. Continue C-locale formatting family and platform backends; retain Windows and Unix destructor-resource differences as partial.
current_work.TKMath: Non-rational global/local high-order cache derivatives, curve/surface transient identity, matrix reindex and Householder reuse hooks, and compact Bnd comparison hooks are implemented with native probes. Generic Bnd type-alias method normalization, descriptor-handle semantics, and mutable cache wrapper integration remain unresolved/partial.
current_work.TKG2d/TKG3d: Public curve/surface adaptor records, shared nullable spline caches, and scoped B-spline pole readers implemented with native probes. Const-reference lifetime parity and cache RTTI remain open.
current_work.TKGeomBase/TKGeomAlgo: Audit missing callable implementations and select dependency blockers.

Common-topology offset experiment held; owner instructed to preserve uncommitted work.

evidence.freshness: Receipts identify source revisions. Declarations, typed runtime expansions, CTest registrations, and supplemental probes have separate counts.
